notes: All numbers are integers. Multipliers are per mille (1000 = unchanged, 1300 = +30%).
earliest_bce is the earliest known real-world date, for calibration only.
invention: relative chance that a city invents the technology on its own (0 = never, baseline 100). diffusion: how readily it spreads to cities in contact (0-1000).
requires: all of these must be known. requires_any: at least one of these. Knowing any variant of a technology counts as knowing it.
needs: the city's surroundings must offer this for the technology (or variant) to be invented or adopted. Resources may be local or reached by trade; the engine decides.
start: share (per mille) of cities at the start year that know it, among cities whose surroundings match 'where' and 'needs'.
variants: regional forms of a technology, each with its own needs, start and extra effects added to the technology's own.
effects: {kind, value, where?, feature?}. 'where' limits an effect to tiles of the given biomes, landforms, soils or water access. Kinds are listed in effect_kinds.

effect_kinds.unlock: Enables a feature (named in 'feature'); value is 1.
effect_kinds.food_yield: Multiplier on food from farmed land.
effect_kinds.fish_yield: Multiplier on food from rivers, lakes and coasts.
effect_kinds.farmable: Makes otherwise unfarmable land farmable, at this per mille of normal yield.
effect_kinds.soil_exhaustion: Multiplier on fertility lost to farming (below 1000 = soils last longer).
effect_kinds.drought_resilience: Per mille of the drought penalty that is avoided.
effect_kinds.irrigation_range: Additive: tiles from a river or lake that count as irrigated.
effect_kinds.salinization: Per mille chance per century that irrigated land loses fertility to salt.
effect_kinds.flood_farming: Per mille of a year's river flood days turned into extra fertility on floodplains.
effect_kinds.food_storage: Additive: months of food that can be stored against bad years.
effect_kinds.preservation: Per mille less loss of stored food.
effect_kinds.season_prediction: Per mille of the harvest loss from badly timed planting that is avoided.
effect_kinds.disease: Multiplier on disease mortality in cities.
effect_kinds.max_city_size: Multiplier on the population a city can hold.
effect_kinds.building_durability: Multiplier on how long buildings last (floods, earthquakes, age).
effect_kinds.construction: Multiplier on building speed and labour efficiency.
effect_kinds.labor_mobilization: Additive: per mille of the population available for public works.
effect_kinds.trade_goods: Additive: tradable goods produced, per mille of population.
effect_kinds.move_cost_land: Multiplier on the cost of moving over land (lower is better).
effect_kinds.move_cost_river: Multiplier on the cost of moving on rivers and lakes.
effect_kinds.move_cost_sea: Multiplier on the cost of moving along coasts and at sea.
effect_kinds.trade_range: Multiplier on how far trade reaches.
effect_kinds.trade_efficiency: Multiplier on the gains from trade.
effect_kinds.diffusion: Multiplier on how readily the city adopts technologies from contacts.
effect_kinds.research: Multiplier on the city's own invention rate.
effect_kinds.tech_retention: Per mille reduction in technologies lost when a city declines or collapses.
effect_kinds.admin_range: Multiplier on the distance over which a city can control others.
effect_kinds.tax_efficiency: Multiplier on the surplus a city can collect as taxes or tribute.
effect_kinds.stability: Additive: per mille shift in internal stability (negative = more unrest).
effect_kinds.mobility: Multiplier on how far armies and raiders move.
effect_kinds.fortification: Additive: per mille bonus to defending a city.
effect_kinds.deforestation: Additive: per mille extra yearly timber and charcoal demand per capita.

resources.copper: Copper ores; most common near volcanic arcs (porphyry deposits) and in old mountain belts.
resources.tin: Tin ores; rare and far apart, usually in granite uplands. The reason for long-distance Bronze Age trade.
resources.arsenic_ores: Arsenic-bearing copper ores (fahlore); found with copper.
resources.gold: Gold; in mountains and as placer gold in rivers below them.
resources.silver: Silver; usually with lead ores in mountains.
resources.lead: Lead ores; in hills and mountains.
resources.salt: Salt; on dry coasts, salt lakes and in deserts.
resources.clay: Clay; on alluvial soils and in river valleys.
resources.stone: Building stone; in hills and mountains.
resources.wild_horses: Wild horses; in grasslands and cold steppes.
resources.wild_asses: Wild asses; in hot deserts, savannas and Mediterranean scrub.
resources.wild_camels: Wild camels; in hot and cold deserts.
